metadata.title: Azita Mohajer · Consultation platform
metadata.description: A case study for Azita Mohajer: a Persian consultation-booking platform with a secure administrative console and a companion Telegram bot.

hero.title: Consultation booking, made simple.
hero.intro: I built Azita Mohajer to make booking a consultation easier, from choosing a time to following up on a request, on the website or through Telegram.
hero.imageAlt: Screenshot of the redesigned Azita Mohajer homepage

system.title: From picking a time to managing bookings.
system.description: A Persian booking experience with a Jalali calendar, a Telegram bot and an admin dashboard.

signals.title: Step-by-step booking
signals.text: Add your details, choose a consultation and book a time.

signals.title: Jalali calendar
signals.text: Browse available days and times to find a slot that works.

signals.title: Telegram bot
signals.text: Book and follow up on consultations right from Telegram.

signals.title: Admin dashboard
signals.text: Manage requests and schedules in a separate, secure workspace.

architecture.title: Behind the project
architecture.paragraph1: Built with Next.js and TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Drizzle for data, and HeroUI and Tailwind CSS for the interface.
architecture.paragraph2: Defined roles, secure sign-in and activity records help keep booking operations organized.
